summary: Iteration-4 scope verified end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_sidra_guests_iter4.py covering PUT /api/quotes/{id}/guests (success + 4 validation paths), auth (401/non-owner 404), cancelled-quote block (400), admin GET quote includes guests, and regression (estimate + list). The member seed quote 6af848ce144d965544a37958 (LAS->MAN pax 2, depart 2026-08-10) was reused; one new TEST quote (DXB->DOH) was created only to exercise the cancelled-quote path (delivered@resend.dev so the team inbox is not hit). Passport is uppercased by the API (ab123456 -> AB123456), DOB-in-future -> 400, passport expiry == depart_date -> 400 ('expires before trip ends'), bad date format -> 422, admin-token on member path -> 404. Frontend (mobile 390x844): trip-manifest-button renders with trip-manifest-count '0 of 2'. Tapping it navigates to /trip/guests/{id}; guest-manifest-screen loads with first guest prefilled with 'Test Member'. guest-nationality/dob/passport/expiry inputs accept values; the dob/expiry inputs format typed digits into YYYY-MM-DD (asDate helper) correctly. manifest-add-guest-button adds a second guest and then disappears when guests==pax. guest-remove-button-N is rendered on each card. manifest-save-button saves and navigates back to the trip detail where trip-manifest-count flips to '1 of 2'. manifest-error correctly surfaces backend 400s - verified with expiry before trip end: 'TEST_UI Two’s passport expires before the trip ends'. Team: /team/{id} shows team-manifest + team-guest-0 / team-guest-1 with full passport (UI111111), nationality, formatted DOB and expiry. Regression: existing quote request flow still returns the quote doc and the seed quote still shows in /api/quotes list. No deprecated expo packages, no React Native red screen, no new critical issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py save_guests uses `<= last_day` for passport expiry — same-day expiry is correctly rejected; message 'expires before the trip ends' reads slightly off when expiry equals depart_date, but functionally correct.
server.py Guest model uses uuid.uuid4().hex[:10] for id; collisions theoretically possible but acceptable for this list length.

frontend trip/guests/[id].tsx direct navigation to /trip/guests/{id} on a cold load may hit the login splash before the auth hydrates (observed during testing) — not a bug, just a UX note: route always reached via trip-manifest-button in practice.
frontend guests PUT body trims full_name/nationality and strips spaces from passport_number before send — matches backend alnum regex; good defensive client-side normalisation.
team/[id].tsx renders Born / Expires with weekday+month-day only, not ISO; still readable, but team-ops may want the year visible for passport expiry sanity-checks.
